name: Tiga Rauleon
japaneseName: ティーガ・ラウレオン
description: Tiga Rauleon is an emissary and knight of the Divine Dragon Church who originally appeared in The Prophecy of the Throne before entering the main light novel series. Serving as a guardian to Saintess Filore within the Filore Camp, he plays an antagonistic role during the events of Arc 10.
